page_title: PAL 1-1 OSA | Las Palmas v Osasuna 24/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+12' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90+10' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make. Osasuna are awarded the free kick.
90+9' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
90+8' 1 - 1 Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) fires a daisy-cutter inside the right post from the free kick just outside the box. Football supporters are always happy to see such a fabulous goal.
90+7' Handball by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna). Las Palmas are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+7' Jesus Manzano blows for a foul after Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+7' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

90+6' The resulting corner from Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) is cleared by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Las Palmas will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' Substitution. Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) on for Alberto Moleiro.
90+2' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Jesus Areso and he is replaced by Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
90+1' Juan Cruz goes off the pitch and Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) comes on.
90' 13 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Close! Abel Bretones (Osasuna) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andy Pelmard (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

86' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Sergio Herrera leaps like a salmon to deny him.
85' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
85' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

85' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Las Palmas.
82' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
81' Here is a change. Alex Suarez is going off and Diego Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Andy Pelmard (Las Palmas).
81' Here comes a substitution. Kirian Rodriguez is given a rest as he is replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas).
79' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Sergio Herrera.
78' The game is interrupted now, Iker Munoz (Osasuna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
77' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
75' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Las Palmas was in an offside position.
72' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
72' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
70' Today's match ends for Ante Budimir who will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
70' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a change. Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) replaces Jon Moncayola.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Las Palmas! Play can continue.

66' Play continues despite the shouts by some Las Palmas players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jesus Manzano interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
66' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Las Palmas for a penalty. Play continues.
65' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
63' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

62' Great save! Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Sergio Herrera. It will be a corner kick for Las Palmas.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' A substitution has been made. Kike Barja goes off and Abel Bretones (Osasuna) comes on.
56' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Manuel Fuster is replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
53' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) was set free in the area by Ante Budimir and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

52' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jesus Manzano blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick is awarded to Osasuna.
52' Kike Barja (Osasuna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Kike Barja (Osasuna) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
49' The attendance is 19762.
48' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
43' Kike Barja (Osasuna) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the right post.
41' The Las Palmas players are exchanging some short passes.

38' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) finds himself some space and fires in a superb first-time shot from long range towards the middle of the goal. Sergio Herrera is alert and makes a good save to deny him.
37' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
36' One of the players from Las Palmas times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
34' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
30' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
30' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Sergio Herrera.
30' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
28' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:0.
24' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.

24' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Sergio Herrera pulls off an easy save.
23' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Jesus Areso (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.

20' A rebound falls to Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kike Barja (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
16' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
15' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

12' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
11' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make. A free kick has been awarded to Osasuna.
10' One of the Las Palmas players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
9' Las Palmas enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

8' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
6' Jesus Manzano interrupts the game. One of the players from Osasuna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
3' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jesus Manzano blows for a foul.
2' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) is caught offside!
1' The first half has started.
Las Palmas will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Jesus Manzano is the one to supervise the game today.
